description: N58 piano lines by elaboration (docs/learned_workflow.md section 6f), driven by the N58 'Piano (D)' 8-bar tables (A aeolian over Am7). Each track starts from one held A4 plus a frozen last note (A4) on beat 1 of bar 8, held 1 bar; each cycle adds one edit (split, join, new note, re-pitch, note to rest). Cycle order reversed: busy -> one held note. 16 tracks x 200 cycles = 1600 bars.
